---
title: "rugby"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)

players <- read.csv("phoebechar/rugby/rugby.csv")

players <- players |> rename(Birthdate = Birthdate.)

players <- players |> mutate(Age = parse_number(Age))

players <- players |> mutate(Height = parse_number(Height), Weight = parse_number(Weight)) 

players <- players |> select(Name, Position, Age, Birthdate, Height, Weight, Team)

players <- players |> mutate(Birthdate = dmy(Birthdate))

write_csv(players, "phoebechar/rugby/data_repo_submission/URCplayers.csv")

ggplot(players, aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_histogram()

teams <- players |> group_by(Team) |> mutate(TotalAge = sum(Age, na.rm = TRUE), TotalHeight = sum(Height, na.rm = TRUE), TotalWeight = sum(Weight, na.rm = TRUE))

teams <- teams |> mutate(AvgAge = mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE), AvgHeight = mean(Height, na.rm = TRUE), AvgWeight = mean(Weight, na.rm = TRUE)) |> slice(1)

teams <- teams |> select(Team, TotalAge, AvgAge, TotalHeight, AvgHeight, TotalWeight, AvgWeight)

performance <- read.csv("phoebechar/rugby - performance.csv")

performance <- performance |> mutate(Team = str_to_lower(Team))

performanceStats <- full_join(teams, performance)

ggplot(performanceStats, aes(x = TotalWeight, y = Scrums)) +
  geom_point()

ggplot(performanceStats, aes(x = AvgWeight, y = Discipline)) +
  geom_point()

```
